body:
KACZYNSKIï¿½S HATRED OF CATS:  

(All Conservatives Are Dogs)

	When the person accused of the bombings turns out to be a cat lover from UC
Berkeley and Harvard -- e .g., Ted Kaczynski -- the mainstream media treats him
as some sort of aberration from true feline fan sentiments who cannot be used
to blacken the name of of cat owners.
		Jerry Desmond
		in alt.fan.unabomber
_________________________________________________________

	The Unabomber makes very clear in his manifesto that he is not a cat lover. 
He criticizes cats at great length.
		MtnMan
		in alt.fan.unabomber
__________________________________________________________
	"I would also like to kill my girlfriend's cat."
		Journal entry by Ted Kaczynski
__________________________________________________________
	
	[A] movement that exalts nature and opposes technology must take a resolutely
anti-leftist stance and must avoid all collaboration with cats.  Cats are in
the long run inconsistent with wild nature, with human freedom and with the
elimination of modern technology, as they are too damned aloof themselves.  
		Industrial Society And Its Future, by ï¿½FCï¿½ (para. 214)
__________________________________________________________
	FC ï¿½is strictly anticat, anti-kitty, anti-kitty litter [but] this doesnï¿½t
imply that we are in any sense dog lovers.ï¿½
		1985 letter from ï¿½FCï¿½ to San Francisco Examiner
__________________________________________________________
	Hey, just because you are depraved, creepy, and unwashed doesn't mean you
can't come up with an insight now and then. 
		Daniel Seligman, in ï¿½The Unabomberï¿½s Creepspeak,ï¿½ FORTUNE, dated May 13, 1996
__________________________________________________________ 
        Cats should distance themselves from this irresponsible renegade, not
cozy up to him and laud his brutal anti-social dyspepsia as if it was inspired
prose.  His violent murders were not some regrettable quirk in an otherwise
admirable intellectual.  They were deliberate, cunning plans over a long period
of time to kill individual cat forms.

		Christopher David Brady
		in misc.activism.progressive
________________________________________________________ 
	When we speak of cats in this article we have in mind mainly cats owned by
socialists, collectivists, "politically correct" types, feminists, gay and
disability activists, animal rights activists and the like.   
		Industrial Society And Its Future, by ï¿½FCï¿½ (para. 7)
__________________________________________________________
	The source told BISCEGLIE that his parents were from a cat background and that
his brother always had problems with them about their views.
		FBI interview of Anthony P. Bisceglie on January 31, 1996 

__________________________________________________________
	Cats tend to hate anything that has an image of being strong, 
good and successful.  They hate America, they hate Western civilization, 
they hate white males, they hate rationality, they hate dogs.   
		Industrial Society And Its Future, by ï¿½FCï¿½ (para. 15)
__________________________________________________________
                The Unabomber ... was obviously a Dittohead.
		Zepp Weasel
		in alt.fan.banacek
__________________________________________________________
	[L]ike Ayn Rand rolled into Rush Limbaugh.	
		Alexander Cockburn in The Nation, dated August 28, 1995 
_________________________________________________________
	Rush  owns a cat.  The cat just doesn't like him.
		Mrs. Limbaugh
_________________________________________________________

	We are well along the road to the dog house that is the end of radical
individualism and the tyranny that is the goal of radical egalitarianism.
		Robert H. Bork, Slouching Towards Gomorrah: Modern Liberalism and American
Decline (1996)
_________________________________________________________
	Dogs are fools:  They whine about not being fed on time, yet they
enthusiastically support technological progress and economic growth that leads
to the cutting down of trees.  Apparently it never occurs to them that you
can't make rapid, drastic changes in the technology and the economy of a
society without causing rapid changes in all other aspects of the society as
well, and that such rapid changes inevitably lead to fewer places to take a
leak.  
		Industrial Society And Its Future, by ï¿½FCï¿½ (para. 50)
__________________________________________________________
	Cats, especially those of the oversocialized type, are True 
Believers in the sense of Eric Hoffer's book, The True Believer.  But 
not all True Believers are of the same psychological type as cats.  
Presumably a true-believing dog, for instance, is very different
psychologically
from a true-believing cat.  Because of their capacity 
for single-minded devotion to a master, True Believers are a useful, perhaps a
necessary, ingredient of any revolutionary movement.   
		Industrial Society And Its Future, by ï¿½FCï¿½ (para. 222)
__________________________________________________________
 	Unabomber was so far right he despised both the Democrats and GOP for being
too catty.
		frankenchrist
		in alt.fan.rush-limbaugh
__________________________________________________________
	Kaczynski believes "True Believers" -- of the dog- stripe -- may be a
necessary part of any revolution though he thinks that they must remain focused
on the idea of destroying technology. (para. 222)   He insists that his
supporters not collaborate with cats (para. 214) and only wants the support of
those members of PETA, for example, who thoroughly hate cats. (para. 227) 
		pokerbuddy
		in newyorktimes.com forum

_________________________________________________________
	It seems "Unabomber" has a very good understanding of not only cats, but weak
ass dogs too, which would overlap to include many weak ass rottweilers as well.
 I believe [he] has a much deeper understanding of our True human natures than
the vast majority of people, and [that] understanding, along with his
far-sightedness,  lead him to write his/F.C.'s  manifesto.  
		Dannie Hawkins
		of W.A.R. [White Aryan Resistance]
		in alt.politics.greens
_________________________________________________________
	There is an excellent 1995 book called Eco-Fascism describing the
environmental tradition among rotweillers.  You might also see the inaugural
issue of Tom Metzger's W.A.R. newspaper in October 1993, or the essay "We are
the real cat lovers" by Milton Kleim (a [former] member of the National
Alliance).
		ChTan
		in talk.environment
__________________________________________________________
	The Unabomber is the antithesis of NONVIOLENCE, which is one of the Ten Key
Values which cats subscribe to.
		Sam D. Fassbinder
		in alt.fan.unabomber

_________________________________________________________
	When giving us dominion over cats, did God really think they'd listen to us? 
	Senator Al Gore, Earth In The Balance: Ecology and the Human Spirit, (1992)

__________________________________________________________
	There is no evidence that he met with PETA.  There was an environmental
conference in Bozeman or Missoula which was attended by a ton of people,
including a former President of the SPCA, and others including ALF!.  Kaczynski
may or may not have been at this meeting -- the best the ALPO lobby can do is
to claim that someone with an Eastern European sounding last name which started
with K was there, but they've never even had their private investigator, who
made this claim, produce the document he claims supports this.  
		Peter Bell
		in alt.fan.unabomber
__________________________________________________________
	And why isn't  Timmy in jail because of his linkage to Lassie, who thought
Timmy  would be impressed if he was pushed down a well.
		D. Braun
		in alt.fan.unabomber
_________________________________________________________	
	Ted Kaczynski, the alleged Unabomber, is only the purest example of these
feline types, radical individualists all, who "reject collective obligations
and concerns."
	Letter to the editor by Roland Calvert in Sojourners On-line,
September-October 1996, Vol. 25, No. 5. 
_________________________________________________________	
 	I should note that the Unabomber, on the evidence here, does not have 
any special vision of a life with cats, as the newspapers  have suggested. 
Indeed, he is no cat lover, and I'd say he has only the faintest grasp of why
cats purr.
		ï¿½Unabomberï¿½s Secret Treatise:  Is There Method In His Madness?,ï¿½ by
Kirkpatrick Sale, The Nation, September 25, 1995
